svg.text: OIDC subject + audience bind role assumption
Deployment role cannot change other environments
No broad administrator policy is required
GitHub Actions deploys only scoped Dev surface
JumpStart S3: List/Get · DJL ECR: pull · /aws/sagemaker/*: Logs write
model load, logs, and image pull only
manual account policies require separate audit
Permission graph reflects the Terraform-managed baseline; residual account policies require a separate IAM audit.
